description: This file defines the TurndownService class, a JavaScript library for converting HTML to Markdown. It includes functions for handling DOM nodes, rules for different HTML elements, and methods for customizing the conversion process.

classes.name: TurndownService
classes.description: Main class providing methods to convert HTML or DOM nodes into Markdown, with customization options and rule management.

classes.name: Rules
classes.description: Helper class managing the set of rules used during HTML to Markdown conversion.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Wrapper for DOM nodes adding properties to facilitate conversion logic.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Utility function to merge objects.

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: Creates a string by repeating a character a specified number of times.

methods.name: isBlock
methods.description: Checks if a DOM node is a block element.

methods.name: isVoid
methods.description: Checks if a DOM node is a void element.

methods.name: hasVoid
methods.description: Checks if a DOM node contains void elements.

methods.name: collapseWhitespace
methods.description: Removes extraneous whitespace from DOM nodes.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a DOM node from the document.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Gets the next sibling node in the DOM.

methods.name: canParseHTMLNatively
methods.description: Checks if the environment supports native HTML parsing.

methods.name: createHTMLParser
methods.description: Creates a DOM parser for environments without native support.

methods.name: shouldUseActiveX
methods.description: Determines if ActiveX should be used for parsing in IE.

methods.name: htmlParser
methods.description: Returns the HTML parser instance.

methods.name: RootNode
methods.description: Creates a root DOM node from an HTML string or existing node, with whitespace collapsed.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Wraps a DOM node with additional properties for processing.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a node is blank (empty or whitespace).

methods.name: flankingWhitespace
methods.description: Determines whitespace around a node.

methods.name: isFlankedByWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a node is flanked by whitespace on a given side.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Converts a DOM node and its children to Markdown.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Finalizes the Markdown output, applying rules.

methods.name: replacementForNode
methods.description: Converts a DOM node to its Markdown representation.

methods.name: joiningNewlines
methods.description: Determines the number of newlines between Markdown segments.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins two Markdown strings with proper spacing.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if input can be converted (string or DOM node).
